task: P8 Site 2 (Mussoorie) preplan scoping — AOI + protection inventory
label: site-definition facts only; no hypothesis, no arm comparison, no outcome

site.anchor_note: Mussoorie town centre; used only to draw AOI rings
site.utm_zone_basis: AOI anchor lon 78.0740 E sets zone 44; the district straddles the 78 E zone edge (extent 77.5759–78.3133 E, 40.0% of area east of 78 E), so an extent/centroid rule would have picked zone 43 and distorted the AOI.

protection.strict_pa_note: no IUCN I-IV, National Park or Wildlife Sanctuary feature intersects Dehradun in this WDPA vintage; the only Ramsar site is Asan (valley, ~4 km2).

notes: WDPA for India includes Reserve/Protected Forest administrative polygons, which is why the union covers 70.9% of the district.
The Doon Valley Ecologically Sensitive Area alone covers 1,779 km2 and overlaps 831 km2 of Reserve Forest; areas are unioned, never summed.
Ring zones are district-clipped: the 8 km ring is only 115.9 km2 of the 201 km2 circle because the district boundary cuts it.
